fda_status: Yes. Corticotropin (Acthar Gel) has been FDA-approved since 1952, and its infantile spasms indication was formally approved in 2010. Its label covers a broad set of conditions, reflecting both its age and its steroid-like breadth of effect.

fda_status: Yes. Cosyntropin (Cortrosyn) has long been FDA-approved as a diagnostic agent for screening adrenocortical insufficiency. It is given as a single injection, with cortisol measured before and after.

summary_es: Inmunosupresor inhibidor de calcineurina con usos sistémicos y oftálmicos. Las formulaciones y vías no son intercambiables automáticamente.
fda_status:
Yes. The FDA approved cyclosporine and two later formulations on this timeline:
Year | FDA approval
1983 | Cyclosporine, for transplant rejection
1995 | Neoral microemulsion
2002 | Restasis eye drop
The systemic formulations carry boxed warnings, including for kidney toxicity and for the increased risk of serious infections and malignancies (especially lymphoma and skin cancer) that comes with immunosuppression.

summary_es: Antibióticos lipoglicopéptidos para determinadas infecciones bacterianas grampositivas; la indicación y precauciones difieren entre productos.
fda_status:
Yes. All three are approved for acute bacterial skin and skin-structure infections. The table shows when each was approved and for what:
Drug | FDA approval | Approved for
Telavancin | 2009 | Acute bacterial skin and skin-structure infections; also hospital-acquired and ventilator-associated bacterial pneumonia due to susceptible S. aureus when alternatives are unsuitable
Dalbavancin | 2014; extended to children from birth in 2021 | Acute bacterial skin and skin-structure infections
Oritavancin | 2014 | Acute bacterial skin and skin-structure infections
Telavancin carries boxed warnings for kidney toxicity and for fetal risk, requiring a pregnancy test before use.

summary_es: Antibiótico lipopeptídico para infecciones grampositivas seleccionadas, incluida bacteriemia por ciertos organismos; no se utiliza para neumonía.
fda_status: Yes. Daptomycin was approved by the FDA in 2003 for complicated skin and skin-structure infections, with the S. aureus bloodstream infection indication (including right-sided endocarditis) added afterward. It is given once daily intravenously.

summary_es: Análogo de glucagón utilizado para hipoglucemia grave; requiere un plan de rescate y seguimiento del episodio.
fda_status: Yes. Dasiglucagon (Zegalogue) is FDA-approved, and its label has changed since approval: Date | FDA action | Who it covers 2021 | Approved for severe hypoglycemia in people with diabetes | Ages 6 and up June 2026 | Label replaced the age limit with a weight limit | Adults and children who weigh at least 20 kg (about 44 pounds) It is available as an autoinjector and a prefilled syringe.

summary_es: Anticoagulante inhibidor directo de trombina utilizado para prevención de trombosis en contextos quirúrgicos seleccionados.
fda_status: Desirudin was approved by the FDA in 2003 for the prevention of deep vein thrombosis in patients undergoing elective hip replacement surgery. The only brand, Iprivask, has since been discontinued in the U.S., and no generic is sold.

summary_es: Análogo de vasopresina con usos específicos en diabetes insípida y ciertas alteraciones hemorrágicas, según formulación; destaca el riesgo de hiponatremia.
fda_status: Yes. Desmopressin was first approved by the FDA in 1978, with later products including the Noctiva nasal spray (2017) and the Nocdurna sublingual tablet (2018) for nocturia. Noctiva and the Stimate nasal spray have since been discontinued in the U.S. Nocdurna carries a boxed warning about the risk of low blood sodium (hyponatremia), as Noctiva did.

summary_es: Agonista opioide kappa periférico utilizado para prurito moderado a intenso asociado a enfermedad renal crónica en adultos en hemodiálisis.
fda_status: Yes. Difelikefalin was approved by the FDA in 2021 for moderate-to-severe pruritus associated with chronic kidney disease in adults on hemodialysis. It is given as an intravenous bolus into the venous line of the dialysis circuit at the end of each session, three times a week.

summary_es: Péptido dirigido a mitocondrias con aprobación acelerada para mejorar fuerza muscular en pacientes seleccionados con síndrome de Barth; otros usos siguen en investigación.
fda_status:
Yes, for one use, through the accelerated pathway. The FDA granted elamipretide accelerated approval on September 19, 2025, as Forzinity, to improve muscle strength in adults and children with Barth syndrome who weigh at least 30 kg. It is the first approved treatment for the condition. The regulatory path was contentious:
- An earlier submission was turned down after the drug missed a walking-distance endpoint.
- The approval was ultimately based on a knee-extensor muscle-strength measure.
- A confirmatory randomized trial was required after approval.
Its other studied uses are not approved.

fda_status: As a tanning peptide, non-FDA-approved and unregulated

summary_es: Agonista experimental de melanocortina promovido para bronceado y función sexual; presenta riesgos y no tiene indicación aprobada por FDA.
fda_status: Non-FDA-approved, unregulated product sold in the gray market

summary_es: Secretagogo oral de GH, no peptídico, investigado en crecimiento y composición corporal; puede alterar glucosa y retención de líquidos.
fda_status: Non-FDA-approved, investigational drug; a small molecule, not a peptide

summary_es: Antagonista CXCR4 utilizado junto a otros agentes para movilización de células madre en pacientes seleccionados.
fda_status: Yes. Motixafortide was approved by the FDA in 2023 for use in combination with filgrastim to mobilize stem cells for collection and subsequent autologous transplantation in patients with multiple myeloma. It is given as a subcutaneous injection, with premedication to reduce the risk of reactions.

summary_es: Péptido mitocondrial investigado en metabolismo y respuesta al ejercicio. No hay beneficio ni seguridad establecidos para inyecciones de energía, pérdida de peso o longevidad.
fda_status: Non-FDA-approved peptide sold in the wellness/gray market

summary_es: Antibacteriano experimental dirigido a bacterias gramnegativas; los resultados y seguridad dependen de la vía y del programa de desarrollo.
fda_status: Investigational antimicrobial peptidomimetic, not approved by the FDA

summary_es: Agonista de GnRH utilizado en endometriosis y pubertad precoz central según etiqueta.
fda_status: Yes. Nafarelin was approved by the FDA in 1990 for endometriosis, with central precocious puberty added shortly afterward. It is marketed as a metered nasal spray delivering 200 micrograms per spray.

summary_es: Péptido inhibidor de TREM-1 investigado para modular inflamación en sepsis y otras condiciones graves.
fda_status: Investigational peptide, not approved by the FDA

summary_es: Péptido natriurético utilizado en determinados contextos de insuficiencia cardiaca aguda; no debe asumirse beneficio en supervivencia.
fda_status: Yes. Nesiritide was approved by the FDA in 2001 for acute decompensated heart failure in patients with shortness of breath at rest or with minimal activity. After the neutral ASCEND-HF results and shifting practice, the product was largely withdrawn from the U.S. market, so its approval is now mainly of historical interest.

summary_es: Análogo experimental de un péptido relacionado con IGF-1 estudiado en trastornos del neurodesarrollo.
fda_status: Investigational peptide, not approved by the FDA

summary_es: Péptido cosmético estudiado para modular pigmentación y mejorar apariencia de manchas; no equivale a un tratamiento médico de toda hiperpigmentación.
fda_status: Does not require FDA approval, as a cosmetic ingredient rather than a drug

summary_es: Análogo de somatostatina utilizado en acromegalia y control de síntomas de ciertos tumores neuroendocrinos; existen usos especializados adicionales.
fda_status: Yes. Octreotide was approved by the FDA in 1988 as the short-acting Sandostatin injection, with the monthly Sandostatin LAR Depot following about a decade later and the oral Mycapssa capsule approved in 2020 for maintenance in acromegaly.

summary_es: Nombre cosmético relacionado con factor de crecimiento epidérmico; los resultados dependen de la formulación y no validan inyecciones cosméticas.
fda_status: Does not require FDA approval, as a cosmetic ingredient rather than a drug

summary_es: Hormona utilizada en obstetricia para indicaciones específicas de contracción uterina; no está validada como terapia general de vínculo o bienestar.
fda_status: Yes. Synthetic oxytocin (Pitocin) is approved by the FDA and has been a standard obstetric drug for decades. Its label carries a boxed warning that it is not indicated for elective induction of labor, meaning induction with no medical reason, because the available data are inadequate to weigh the benefits against the risks.

summary_es: Ingrediente cosmético estudiado para apariencia y elasticidad cutánea; la evidencia clínica es limitada.
fda_status: Does not require FDA approval, as a cosmetic ingredient rather than a drug

summary_es: Péptido cosmético tópico estudiado para apariencia de arrugas y matriz de la piel; el beneficio depende del producto.
fda_status: Does not require FDA approval, as a cosmetic ingredient rather than a drug

summary_es: Ingrediente cosmético utilizado en formulaciones para mejorar apariencia de piel; los estudios de mezclas no aíslan siempre su efecto.
fda_status: Does not require FDA approval, as a cosmetic ingredient rather than a drug

summary_es: Péptido cosmético investigado en señalización de matriz cutánea; no demuestra por sí solo un efecto clínico de rejuvenecimiento.
fda_status: Does not require FDA approval, as a cosmetic ingredient rather than a drug

summary_es: Ingrediente cosmético estudiado para apariencia de líneas y textura cutánea; los datos dependen de la formulación.
fda_status: Does not require FDA approval, as a cosmetic ingredient rather than a drug

summary_es: Terapia de reemplazo de PTH utilizada en adultos con hipoparatiroidismo; requiere control de calcio y seguimiento específico.
fda_status: Yes. Palopegteriparatide was approved by the FDA in 2024 as Yorvipath for hypoparathyroidism in adults, following earlier approval in Europe. Its label warns of a potential risk of osteosarcoma, based on rat studies of parathyroid hormone analogs, and it is not recommended for people at increased risk of that cancer. It is given as a once-daily subcutaneous injection.

summary_es: Hormona paratiroidea utilizada en productos e indicaciones endocrinas específicas; disponibilidad y formulación deben verificarse.
fda_status: Yes. Parathyroid hormone (Natpara) was approved by the FDA in 2015 for hypoparathyroidism. It carries a boxed warning about osteosarcoma seen in rats and is available only through a restricted program. Its U.S. availability has been limited following a 2019 recall over a manufacturing issue and the manufacturer's decision to discontinue the product; the newer long-acting agent palopegteriparatide (Yorvipath) has since been approved for the same condition.

summary_es: Análogo de somatostatina utilizado en enfermedad de Cushing o acromegalia según formulación; puede producir hiperglucemia.
fda_status: Yes. Pasireotide was approved by the FDA in stages: Year | Product | Approved for 2012 | Signifor | Cushing's disease when surgery is not an option or has not worked 2014 | Signifor LAR (long-acting) | Acromegaly Later | Signifor LAR (long-acting) | Cushing's disease

summary_es: Inhibidor de complemento C3 con usos hematológicos u oftálmicos específicos según producto y vía; las formulaciones no son intercambiables.
fda_status:
Yes. The FDA has approved pegcetacoplan under two brand names, as the table shows:
Year | Product | Approved for
2021 | Empaveli | PNH
2023 | Syfovre | Geographic atrophy secondary to age-related macular degeneration
2025 | Empaveli | C3 glomerulopathy and primary immune-complex membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis (IC-MPGN), 2 rare kidney diseases
Empaveli carries a boxed warning for serious infections caused by encapsulated bacteria, so it requires vaccination against those bacteria and is available only through a restricted program.

summary_es: Antagonista del receptor de GH utilizado para acromegalia; bloquea la acción de GH en lugar de estimularla.
fda_status: Yes. Pegvisomant was approved by the FDA in 2003 for acromegaly. It is given as a daily subcutaneous injection, usually starting with a loading dose and then a daily maintenance dose titrated to IGF-1 levels.

summary_es: Agonista dual de GLP-1 y glucagón investigado en obesidad y enfermedad hepática metabólica.
fda_status: Investigational peptide, not approved by the FDA or any regulator

summary_es: Ingrediente cosmético estudiado para líneas de expresión, a menudo en mezclas; no equivale a toxina botulínica.
fda_status: Does not require FDA approval, as a cosmetic ingredient rather than a drug

summary_es: Análogo de amilina de acción prolongada investigado para obesidad; su eficacia y seguridad se evalúan en ensayos.
fda_status: Investigational peptide, not approved by the FDA or any regulator

summary_es: Agonista de guanilato ciclasa C utilizado en adultos con estreñimiento crónico o intestino irritable con estreñimiento.
fda_status: Yes. Plecanatide was approved by the FDA in 2017 for chronic idiopathic constipation and later for irritable bowel syndrome with constipation in adults. Its label carries a boxed warning about the risk of serious dehydration in children: it is contraindicated in children under 6 and should be avoided in those 6 to under 18.

summary_es: Péptido oral antagonista de integrina investigado para colitis ulcerosa; resultados experimentales no constituyen una indicación aprobada.
fda_status: Investigational peptide, not approved by the FDA

summary_es: Antibióticos peptídicos para determinadas bacterias gramnegativas; productos sistémicos requieren especial atención a toxicidad renal y neurológica.
fda_status:
Yes. Both polymyxin B and colistin (as colistimethate) were approved by the FDA decades ago for serious Gram-negative infections. The table below compares how their labels warn about toxicity.
Product | Label warning
Injectable polymyxin B | Boxed warning about kidney toxicity and neurotoxicity, including the risk of respiratory paralysis from neuromuscular blockade
Colistimethate | Warnings about the same risks, though not in boxed form

summary_es: Análogo de amilina utilizado como complemento de insulina en pacientes seleccionados con diabetes; aumenta el riesgo de hipoglucemia si no se ajusta el tratamiento.
fda_status: FDA-approved peptide, sold as Symlin, used alongside insulin at mealtimes

summary_es: Otro nombre de bremelanotide. La aprobación corresponde a un producto e indicación específicos; no valida cualquier preparación ni usos de rendimiento sexual.
fda_status:
Not as sold on the gray market. The approved product and the gray-market product differ on status and population:
Attribute | Vyleesi (bremelanotide) | Gray-market "PT-141"
FDA status | FDA-approved in 2019 | An unapproved use and an unregulated source, not Vyleesi, and not FDA quality-controlled
Population | Premenopausal women with HSDD | Marketed for men and for general libido
Vyleesi is given as an on-demand self-injection. Gray-market "PT-141" was not among the peptides reviewed favorably at the 2026 FDA compounding advisory meetings.

summary_es: Agonista triple de GIP, GLP-1 y glucagón en investigación para obesidad y condiciones metabólicas. No debe presentarse como medicamento aprobado ni como producto disponible para preparación rutinaria.
fda_status: Investigational peptide, not yet approved by the FDA

summary_es: Mimético de hepcidina utilizado para controlar eritrocitosis en adultos con policitemia vera; actúa sobre disponibilidad de hierro.
fda_status: Yes. The FDA approved rusfertide on August 28, 2026, as Mimrylo for adults with polycythemia vera, a first-in-class approval for a hepcidin-mimetic peptide, based on the Phase 3 VERIFY trial.

summary_es: Hormona utilizada en pruebas diagnósticas de función pancreática y procedimientos seleccionados; no es una terapia general digestiva.
fda_status: Yes. Synthetic human secretin (ChiRhoStim) was approved by the FDA in 2004 for these diagnostic uses: Diagnostic use | What secretin does Diagnosis of exocrine pancreatic dysfunction | Stimulates pancreatic secretions Diagnosis of gastrinoma | Stimulates gastrin secretion Endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) | Helps identify the pancreatic ducts

summary_es: Péptido experimental investigado por posibles efectos sobre ansiedad; la evidencia no establece un tratamiento aprobado por FDA.
fda_status: Not FDA-approved, sold in the wellness/gray market, and approved in Russia

summary_es: Agonista de receptor V1a investigado para shock séptico; los resultados de investigación no establecen uso clínico rutinario.
fda_status: Investigational peptide, not approved by the FDA

summary_es: Agonista GLP-1 utilizado en diabetes tipo 2 y manejo de peso según producto; otras indicaciones y beneficios dependen de la etiqueta y población. Una preparación compuesta no hereda aprobación del medicamento comercial.
fda_status: FDA-approved GLP-1 peptide, sold under the brand names Ozempic, Wegovy, and Rybelsus

summary_es: Péptido experimental investigado en funciones neurológicas. Estudios regionales o preclínicos no demuestran eficacia para mejorar cognición en personas sanas.
fda_status: Not FDA-approved, sold in the wellness/gray market, and approved in Russia

summary_es: Análogo de GHRH con antecedentes de productos aprobados y posteriormente descontinuados; las preparaciones compuestas actuales no están aprobadas por FDA por ese antecedente.
fda_status: No FDA-approved sermorelin product currently marketed; supplied via compounding

summary_es: Agonista MC4R utilizado para formas genéticas específicas de obesidad; no se utiliza para cualquier obesidad.
fda_status:
Yes. Setmelanotide was approved by the FDA for chronic weight management, with indications added in stages.
Indication | FDA approval | Approved ages
Obesity due to confirmed POMC, PCSK1, or LEPR deficiency | 2020 | 2 years and older, lowered since first approval
Obesity due to Bardet-Biedl syndrome | 2022 | 2 years and older, lowered since first approval
Acquired hypothalamic obesity | March 2026 | Adults and children 4 and older

summary_es: Análogo de colecistoquinina utilizado como apoyo en pruebas diagnósticas de función biliar y pancreática.
fda_status: Yes. Sincalide (Kinevac) was approved by the FDA in 1976. It is approved to: - Stimulate gallbladder contraction - Stimulate pancreatic secretion (often alongside secretin) - Speed the transit of barium through the small bowel to shorten imaging time

summary_es: Análogo de GH de acción prolongada utilizado para deficiencia de hormona de crecimiento en poblaciones definidas por etiqueta.
fda_status:
Yes. Somapacitan was approved by the FDA in 2020, and its approved uses have grown since:
Date | Approved use added
2020 | Adults with growth hormone deficiency
2023 | Pediatric growth hormone deficiency
February 2026 | Idiopathic short stature in children 2.5 and older
February 2026 | Short stature in children 2.5 and older born small for gestational age
February 2026 | Growth failure from Noonan syndrome in children 2.5 and older
It is given as a once-weekly subcutaneous injection.

summary_es: Hormona de crecimiento recombinante para deficiencias y trastornos específicos; no es una indicación aprobada de rejuvenecimiento general.
fda_status: Yes. Recombinant human growth hormone products have been FDA-approved since the late 1980s, beginning with Humatrope in 1987, and many brands have followed. The approved indications vary by product but are extensive, covering pediatric and adult growth hormone deficiency and several specific syndromes.

summary_es: Agonista dual de GLP-1 y glucagón investigado en obesidad y enfermedad hepática metabólica.
fda_status: Investigational peptide, not approved by the FDA or any regulator

summary_es: Nombre utilizado para productos relacionados con fragmentos de timosina beta-4; identidad y evidencia no son intercambiables con la proteína completa. No hay eficacia clínica establecida para recuperación de lesiones.
fda_status: Not FDA-approved, sold in the wellness/gray market

summary_es: Análogo de GLP-2 utilizado en síndrome de intestino corto con dependencia de soporte parenteral; exige seguimiento especializado.
fda_status: Yes. Teduglutide was approved by the FDA in 2012 for short bowel syndrome in adults dependent on parenteral support, with a later pediatric approval for children 1 year and older. It is given as a once-daily subcutaneous injection.

summary_es: Análogo de PTH utilizado para osteoporosis de alto riesgo; estimula formación ósea y requiere evaluación de contraindicaciones.
fda_status:
Yes. Teriparatide's FDA label has changed since approval:
Year | Label status
2002 | Approved for osteoporosis, with a boxed warning because high, lifelong doses caused osteosarcoma (a bone cancer) in rats, along with a 2-year limit on cumulative use
2020 | After years of human data showed no increased osteosarcoma signal, the FDA removed the boxed warning and kept osteosarcoma as a standard warning
Now | Use beyond 2 years should be considered only if a person remains at high risk of fracture

summary_es: Análogo de vasopresina utilizado en adultos con síndrome hepatorrenal con deterioro rápido de función renal; presenta riesgo respiratorio importante.
fda_status: Yes. Terlipressin (Terlivaz) was approved by the FDA in 2022 to improve kidney function in adults with hepatorenal syndrome with rapid reduction in kidney function. It carries a boxed warning for serious or fatal respiratory failure and is avoided in patients who are already hypoxic.

summary_es: Análogo de GHRH con una indicación específica para exceso de grasa abdominal asociado a lipodistrofia por VIH. Su uso para adelgazar o rejuvenecer fuera de ese contexto no debe presentarse como aprobado.
fda_status: Yes. Tesamorelin was approved by the FDA in 2010 as Egrifta, with later formulations marketed as Egrifta SV and Egrifta WR. It is given as a daily subcutaneous injection.

summary_es: Péptido inmunomodulador estudiado en infecciones y otras condiciones. El uso en otros países no equivale a una indicación aprobada por FDA para fortalecer defensas.
fda_status: Not FDA-approved in the U.S.; approved as thymalfasin (Zadaxin) in many other countries

summary_es: Péptido endógeno investigado en reparación y cicatrización; no deben trasladarse sus resultados a productos etiquetados TB-500.
fda_status: Not FDA-approved, sold in the wellness/gray market

summary_es: Péptido relacionado con función tímica estudiado principalmente en investigación; no hay beneficio clínico establecido para rejuvenecer o reforzar defensas.
fda_status: Not FDA-approved, sold in the wellness/gray market

summary_es: Agonista dual GIP/GLP-1 utilizado en diabetes tipo 2 y manejo de peso según producto; beneficios e indicaciones dependen de la etiqueta. Añadir glicina o B6 no confiere aprobación a una preparación compuesta.
fda_status: FDA-approved peptide, sold as Mounjaro for type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular risk reduction and as Zepbound for weight management and obstructive sleep apnea

summary_es: Ingrediente cosmético estudiado para organización de matriz cutánea y apariencia de piel; los datos clínicos son limitados.
fda_status: As a cosmetic ingredient rather than a drug, does not require FDA approval

summary_es: Agonista de GnRH utilizado en supresión hormonal para indicaciones específicas, como cáncer de próstata o pubertad precoz según producto.
fda_status: Yes. The FDA has approved triptorelin as two products, first Trelstar and later Triptodur. Product | FDA approval | Approved for Trelstar depot | 2000 | Advanced prostate cancer Triptodur, the 6-month formulation | 2017 | Central precocious puberty It is available in 1-, 3-, and 6-month depot strengths.

summary_es: Análogo derivado de IGF-1 con una indicación específica para síndrome de Rett. Los programas de investigación para otras enfermedades no comparten esa aprobación.
fda_status: FDA-approved as DAYBUE for Rett syndrome; other (predecessor) programs are investigational

summary_es: Análogo derivado de IGF-1 con una indicación específica para síndrome de Rett. Los programas de investigación para otras enfermedades no comparten esa aprobación.
fda_status: Yes. Trofinetide (DAYBUE) was approved by the FDA in 2023 for the treatment of Rett syndrome in adults and children 2 years and older. It was the first approved treatment for the condition. DAYBUE Stix, a powder that is mixed into a solution, appears in the current prescribing information, revised in December 2025.

summary_es: Antibiótico glucopéptido para determinadas infecciones grampositivas; la vía oral y la intravenosa tienen indicaciones y exposición muy diferentes.
fda_status: Yes. Vancomycin has been FDA-approved since 1958 and is available as intravenous formulations and an oral form. Its approved uses span serious Gram-positive infections systemically and C. difficile infection and staphylococcal enterocolitis when given orally.

summary_es: Hormona vasopresora utilizada en shock vasodilatador seleccionado; requiere monitorización hospitalaria.
fda_status: Yes. Vasopressin injection (Vasostrict) received full FDA approval in 2014 to raise blood pressure in adults with vasodilatory shock who remain hypotensive despite fluids and catecholamines. It is given as a continuous intravenous infusion in a monitored setting.

summary_es: Análogo de péptido natriurético tipo C utilizado para aumentar crecimiento lineal en pacientes pediátricos con acondroplasia y epífisis abiertas.
fda_status: Yes. Vosoritide (Voxzogo) was approved by the FDA in 2021 for achondroplasia in children with open epiphyses (growth plates). It holds accelerated approval, based on faster annual growth, and continued approval may depend on confirmatory trials. The approved age range was initially 5 years and older, and since October 2023 it covers children of all ages with open growth plates.

summary_es: Analgésico intratecal bloqueador de canales de calcio utilizado en dolor crónico grave seleccionado; requiere manejo especializado por riesgos neuropsiquiátricos.
fda_status: Yes. Ziconotide (Prialt) was approved by the FDA in 2004 for the management of severe chronic pain in patients for whom intrathecal therapy is warranted and who are intolerant of or refractory to other treatments. It carries a boxed warning for severe psychiatric symptoms and neurological impairment and is contraindicated in people with a history of psychosis.

summary_es: Inhibidor de complemento C5 utilizado en adultos seleccionados con miastenia gravis generalizada; requiere medidas específicas frente a infección meningocócica.
fda_status: Yes. Zilucoplan was approved by the FDA in 2023 for generalized myasthenia gravis in adults who are anti-acetylcholine-receptor antibody positive. It carries a boxed warning for serious meningococcal infections, requires meningococcal vaccination, and is dispensed only through a risk management program.
